deploy._comment_migrations: Migrations run as the OWNER before the new revision serves traffic. The API itself connects as builder_app, which is NOBYPASSRLS and cannot alter tables — that separation is what lets boot.py assert the request path is unprivileged.
deploy._comment_replicas: One replica. Not a scaling opinion: any scheduled work added later must live in a separate cron service, because an in-process scheduler double-fires at two replicas and loses its job store on redeploy.
